scripts.allure:gen:safe: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='allure-results';if(!fs.existsSync(p)||fs.readdirSync(p).length===0){console.log('[allure] no results, skipping generate');process.exit(0)}" && npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.allure:open:safe: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('allure-report')){console.log('[allure] no report to open, skipping');process.exit(0)}" && npx allure open allure-report
scripts.report:dev: npm run allure:reset && (npm run test:dev   || true) && npm run allure:gen:safe && npm run allure:open:safe
scripts.report:stage: npm run allure:reset && (npm run test:stage || true) && npm run allure:gen:safe && npm run allure:open:safe
scripts.report:prod: npm run allure:reset && (npm run test:prod || true) && npm run allure:gen:safe && npm run allure:open:safe
scripts.report:dev:history: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:dev && npm run allure:keep-history && npm run allure:gen && npm run allure:open
scripts.report:stage:history: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:stage && npm run allure:keep-history && npm run allure:gen && npm run allure:open
scripts.report:prod:history: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:prod && npm run allure:keep-history && npm run allure:gen && npm run allure:open
scripts.report:prod:keep-exit: npm run allure:reset && (npm run test:prod; code=$?; npm run allure:gen:safe; npm run allure:open:safe; exit $code)
